symptom: At approximately 15:00 Israel time, the authenticated VII admin dashboard displayed בוקר טוב, Adir.
expected_behavior: The greeting reflects the current Israel-local period and displays צהריים טובים at 15:00.
environment: VII temporary production release 427 at https://vii.spaplus.co/admin on 2026-10-15, authenticated administrator view.

steps: Open the authenticated production admin dashboard at 15:00 Israel time.
reproduction.evidence: User-supplied screenshot C:/Users/Adir/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-clipboard-de45587d-25f9-483e-b64e-cfaa26952844.png shows בוקר טוב, Adir at the reported afternoon time.

observations.observation: The admin heading interpolated the administrator name into a literal בוקר טוב string.
No time lookup participated in the heading before the fix.
observations.evidence: Repository search found no getHours or greeting helper used by app/admin/page.tsx.

hypotheses.mechanism: The visible greeting is hardcoded rather than derived from the current time.
hypotheses.prediction: The source contains a literal morning greeting and no time-dependent selection.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the exact dashboard heading expression.
hypotheses.result: The source used a literal morning greeting for every named administrator.

hypotheses.mechanism: A UTC or daylight-saving conversion turns 15:00 Israel time into a morning period.
hypotheses.prediction: A time conversion exists but uses the host timezone or an incorrect offset.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search the dashboard source for Date, getHours, Intl and timezone usage in the heading path.
hypotheses.result: No time conversion existed in the heading path, so timezone conversion could not cause the original symptom.

hypotheses.mechanism: A stale response or browser cache preserves an earlier morning label.
hypotheses.prediction: The current source computes a dynamic greeting but production displays an older value.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare current source behavior with the literal rendered text.
hypotheses.result: The source itself always emitted בוקר טוב, so cache behavior was not required to reproduce the defect.

fix.change: Added a pure Israel-time greeting selector using Intl.DateTimeFormat with Asia/Jerusalem, replaced the literal label, and refresh it every minute and when the tab visibility changes.
fix.evidence: tests/admin-israel-greeting.test.mjs passes winter, summer, all four boundaries, 15:00, and dashboard wiring checks.

regression_checks.check: Full project build and regression suite
regression_checks.evidence: pnpm test: build completed and 745/745 tests passed.
audit_font_sources.py passed for the full repository.

remaining_unknowns: Exact production rendering remains to be checked after publication.
authorization_boundary: Repair, test, publish and verify the reported VII administration defect without changing unrelated data or configuration.
